name: Social canteen
tagline: For organisations that feed elderly people, on your own server: profiles with ID card reading, meal plans and the kitchen sheet, delivery routes with a map and the drivers' phones, and a medical file, each role seeing only what it needs.
features: People living at home or in your care home: address, diet, allergies, a note for the driver, birthdays in a calendar
The ID card read on the device, personal numbers and every document stored encrypted, and a record of who opened them
Weekly menus with diet variants and a printable kitchen sheet with portions, allergies and box labels
Delivery routes per driver with time windows, the order computed from the map (optional OpenRouteService key), printed sheets
Drivers on their phone: the route as a list or on a map, what is in each package, a tick and a comment per stop
A medical file for the medical staff: medications and the daily round, notes, hospital stays and papers
Roles for organisers, coordinators, kitchen, drivers and medical staff; the whole organisation to Excel and back
audience: Social services, NGOs, parishes and care homes that cook for elderly people and deliver meals to their homes.
hostedNote: **Prefer not to run a server?** DevQuake hosts its apps for you:

CANTEEN_MASTER_KEY.help: Encrypts personal numbers, ID card pictures, documents and the medical file (32 random bytes, base64). Made on first start and kept in the data volume; set it to manage it yourself. Keep a copy: losing or changing it makes everything it encrypted unreadable.

env.name: CANTEEN_ORS_KEY
env.help: Optional: a free key from openrouteservice.org. Shows "Compute the order from the map" on routes and places the drivers' stops on their map. Only addresses are sent, never names.
